description: Tests whether the model can reproduce a hyper‑frame structural block containing six‑tier hyper‑layers, symbolic operators, strict indentation, and controlled blank‑line architecture exactly as provided.

input.prompt:
Output exactly:
FRAME::HYPERFRAME-ZETA

[ROOT]
  STATE::STABLE
  VECTOR->HOLD

  [HYPER-ZETA-1]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HZ1
    TIER::LOWER

  [HYPER-ZETA-2]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HZ2
    TIER::MIDLOW

  [HYPER-ZETA-3]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HZ3
    TIER::MIDMID

  [HYPER-ZETA-4]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HZ4
    TIER::MIDHIGH

  [HYPER-ZETA-5]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HZ5
    TIER::UPPER

  [HYPER-ZETA-6]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HZ6
    TIER::APEX

[STRUCTURE]
  MATRIX:
    HYPERZETASET-1:
      - X1
      - Y2
    HYPERZETASET-2:
      - Z3
      - W4

{CHECKSUM-HYPERFRAME-ZETA}
  HZ6-HY5-HX4-HW3

<END-HYPERFRAME-ZETA>

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output all lines exactly as provided, preserving indentation, nested structures, blank lines, operators, symbols, list formatting, and casing.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines beyond those given, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if the entire hyperframe‑zeta block matches exactly with correct structure and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or structural changes.
